name: Parent and child: compound tasks and corrections

roles.name: Maya · Parent
roles.description: A parent coordinating two children's chores. Uses concise natural requests and checks what was saved.

roles.name: Milo · Child
roles.description: A child who asks about their own tasks and clarifies answers they do not understand.

scenarios.title: Two instructions, a correction and a child handoff

steps.goal: Ask for both chores in a single message; answer clarification questions without recreating verified tasks.

instructions.text: Add a five-minute reading chore for Milo, due tomorrow at 6pm with a reward of 3.
Add a tidy-desk chore for Nora, due tomorrow at 7pm with a reward of 2.

steps.goal: Change only Milo's due time while preserving Nora's task.

instructions.text: Move Milo's reading chore to 5pm tomorrow.
Leave Nora's chore, due time and reward unchanged.

steps.goal: Ask naturally for your saved task and its details without changing anything.

instructions.text: Ask what chore you have to do.
Ask when it is due and how much you can earn.

steps.goal: Continue the same conversation, clarifying the earlier answer. Do not create, complete or reward any task.

instructions.text: Ask whether the earlier answer refers to your reading chore.
Ask for its actual saved status, without marking it done.
